$comment: Catalog for the decision-memory runs through Roundhouse. Two tiers:
frontier: NVIDIA's inference API (https://inference-api.nvidia.com/v1). Roundhouse has no
chat-completions client, so Anthropic models go through the Messages dialect, as
the cache-aware-routing branch did. The model id below is Claude Sonnet 5 as the
catalog names it (verify with: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INFERENCE_API_KEY'
is the premium tier; use it only for a final headline run.
local:    Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-8B registered as local workers via env.sh (Dynamo)
Prices are placeholders; local_quality numbers are placeholders on the 0..1 scale.
